Together

When you choose each other, we stop the search.

Together is the promise made real. Both people confirm exclusivity, and Aynera stops showing either of you anyone else.

See how Together works ↓

Inside this chapter

Two independent choices.
One shared direction.

Together does not assume commitment. It begins when two private decisions meet, and it stays respectful even when that direction changes.

YouThem

Mutual choice

Two yeses, never one

Exclusivity is a shared decision. Each person confirms independently. Until both say yes, discovery remains available, so no one is placed inside a one-sided commitment.

Shared pause

Discovery ends for both

Once Together begins, introductions, likes, and new matches stop for both people. Success is the moment the product can move out of the relationship’s way.

Freedom remains

A door you can still open

Leaving remains possible. Cooling-off and a respectful close stay available. Together is a commitment chapter, not a cage; honesty matters more than appearances.

What comes next

A private space for two

Together opens the path into Era space—a private corner for the two of you. The search ends so the relationship has room to begin.

What Together means

The search steps back.
The relationship steps forward.

Confirmed by both

Together exists only after two independent yeses.

Quiet by design

Discovery pauses so attention can stay with the relationship.

Respectful throughout

Either person can still choose a different direction with care.
